packages.label: רוּחַ מָשִׁיחַ וְחֹטֶם
packages.label_en: Spirit of Messiah and the Nose
packages.reason: All nodes in this package are expressions of the same essential Mashiach-force. Mashiach is identified with the nose (חֹטֶם) as the seat of breath/spirit ('רוּחַ אַפֵּינוּ מְשִׁיחַ ה''); his spirit (רוּחוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ) is identified with the divine wind that hovered over creation (רוּחַ אֱלֹקִים), and operationally that same spirit becomes the ruach-kina'ah — the spirit of zealous guarding — when it encounters impurity. These are not cause-and-effect steps; they are three faces of the same Mashiach dimension: its physical locus (nose), its divine origin (ruach Elohim at creation), and its active manifestation in the world (ruach kina'ah). Together they form one bechina-cluster: the Spirit of Mashiach.

merge_notes.reason: This isolated pair (raw component C3) represents the physical-name dimension of Mashiach: 'מָשִׁיחַ הוּא בְּחִינוֹת חֹטֶם' — the nose is the physical locus of the Mashiach-spirit. The nose is where breath/ruach enters and exits. C3 and C1 (רוחו של משיח, רוח קנאה, רוח אלקים) share the same essential nature — the Mashiach force. C3 is the body; C1 is the spirit of that same body. This is bechina (same essence), not eitza (cause→effect). Merged into Package 1.

packages.label: סֵפֶר וְשֵׁם ה' וְתוֹרָה
packages.label_en: The Holy Book, the Name of God, and Torah
packages.reason: All nodes in this package are expressions of the same sacred written/revealed domain. The ספר (holy book) is a bechina of שם ה' (Name of God), because 'ספר במספר שם' (Zohar), and it is specifically 'שמי שנכתב בקדשה ונתפשט בעולם ועושה שם' — the written Name that spreads through the world. Meanwhile, Torah itself is identified with מים (water): 'מַיִם הוּא הַתּוֹרָה'. The holy book is the face/revelation (פני האורייתא) of Torah; Torah/water is the deeper substrate. The ספר is the sanctified outer form through which Torah (as divine Name) enters the world. All five nodes — ספר, שם ה, שמי שנכתב בקדשה, מים, תורה — are aspects of the same revelatory-sacred dimension: the written Word of God.
nodes: שמי שנכתב בקדשה, ונתפשט בעולם ועושה שם

merge_notes.reason: This isolated pair (raw component C2) establishes that Torah is water: 'מַיִם הוּא הַתּוֹרָה, כַּמּוּבָא'. The proof text in which this appears is the same passage explaining that Mashiach's spirit hovers over the books 'כְּרוּחַ אֱלֹקִים מְרַחֶפֶת עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם'. The ספר is the 'face' (פני) of Torah/water — it is the revealed surface on which Mashiach's spirit rests. מים/תורה are the underlying sacred substance; ספר/שם ה are its outward, named form. This is bechina (same essence seen from different angles), not eitza. Merged into Package 2.
